breakpoints.note: sc_asn1_decode successfully parses the crafted ASN.1 data without returning an error, causing the decode entry function to populate obj and return SC_SUCCESS.

The PKCS#15 decode entry function parses the attacker-controlled ASN.1 buffer via sc_asn1_decode, populating obj->type and obj->data on success and returning SC_SUCCESS, which triggers the while-loop body containing the free.

After a successful decode, sc_pkcs15_free_object(obj) frees the object inside the while-loop body, but no reallocation of obj (obj = calloc(1, sizeof *obj)) follows before the stale pointer is reused on the next iteration or at the post-loop cleanup.
